CustomField.label: Offer Alert Due Date
CustomField.description: The other half of the call-for-offers alert idempotency marker (O2), and it is LOAD-BEARING rather than defensive polish. It snapshots the Offer Due Date that Offer Alert Last Interval was computed against. CallForOffersStampService is LAST-EMAIL-WINS on Offer Due Date ON PURPOSE - a call-for-offers deadline is a fact that changes ("extended to Friday") - so without this snapshot an extension would leave the marker armed against a date that no longer exists and the re-armed ladder would never fire again. CallForOffersAlertBatch compares this to the live Offer Due Date and, when they differ, treats the marker as blank and re-runs the whole 7 / 3 / 1 / 0 ladder against the new deadline. This is what lets the stamp service move the deadline while knowing nothing at all about the alert feature. Written by CallForOffersAlertBatch in system mode.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set by the daily call-for-offers alert job. The Offer Due Date that the last alert was sent against; when the deal's Offer Due Date changes, the alerts start again.
